name: Smarthome Featureofinterest Pattern
scenarios: A feature of interest can be "the pressure sensed on the couch" or "the electric-current of the TV".
competency_questions: What is the object which is the interest of the observation process? Which property pf this object is important?; Which sensing process (SSN:Sensing) is monitoring the state of the feature of interest (i.e. a specific property of the object)
